records.title: MBC6 conformance ROM scope is CGB-only and covers all 128 physical ROM banks
records.content: The original user specification requires a self-contained 1 MiB CGB-only MBC6 conformance ROM, with unique deterministic signatures for all 128 physical 8 KiB banks and independent tests of both ROM and SRAM windows. Do not broaden the target to DMG/MGB/SGB or dual-mode operation. Test data, graphics, fonts, and fixtures must be generated from source; do not use commercial Net de Get ROM data, copyrighted assets, extracted firmware, or proprietary binaries.

records.title: Mapper-changing routines stay in fixed ROM and flash polling stays bounded
records.content: The user specification requires startup, MBC6 register helpers, dispatcher, display, result formatting, input, flash helpers, and core assertions to run from fixed ROM at $0000-$3FFF. Never execute code from a switchable window while remapping that same address space. Flash status polling must have a software timeout, preserve diagnostic status, and continue safely where possible; no test may hang forever.
